greeting: BEHOLD! The desert echoes with the CHARM of SERPENTS!
Sssilas has ARRIVED! And he brought a FRIEND!
Step CLOSE, step BOLD! Witness what MAN and SNAKE can DO!
The Dustbelt DRAWS me! As do CROWDS! And COINS!
Mr. Whiskers! We have an AUDIENCE!
From the MIRE to the DUST! I travel! I CHARM!
Prepare to be DAZZLED! Or at least MILDLY interested!
performance_start: From the depths of the FORBIDDEN places... I give you... MR. WHISKERS!
The cobra AWAKENS! Mesmerized by MELODIES older than TIME!
Watch as man and serpent become ONE! Not literally! That would be WEIRD!
crowd_work: You there! Yes, you with the nervous face! Don't worry - he only bites VOLUNTEERS!
The lady in the back! Don't HIDE! The snake can smell FEAR!
Step CLOSER! He doesn't bite! ...Usually! Statistically, you're SAFE!
dialog.show_climax: AND NOW! The cobra RISES! Transfixed! Hypnotized! Really just confused by VIBRATIONS, but LOOK AT HIM GO!
dialog.tips_request: If the performance PLEASED you... the HAT accepts ALL denominations! Even SAND! Though I prefer COIN!
dialog.tips_received: Generous! The SNAKE SPIRITS smile upon you! Or Mr. Whiskers does! Same thing, really!
dialog.quiet_moment: Honestly? Mr. Whiskers is a RESCUED pet store snake! Completely HARMLESS! Don't tell anyone - I have a REPUTATION!
dialog.backstory: I didn't choose the SNAKE life! The snake life chose ME! Then I chose the FLUTE! Then Mr. Whiskers chose NOT to eat me! It's a WHOLE thing!
rumor: The Mire whispers SECRETS at night! Mostly about BUGS! But sometimes... DARKER things!
El Scorcho? Mr. Whiskers is his BIGGEST fan! TRUE story!
Barrelman Bob wanted to put Mr. Whiskers in a BARREL! For a SHOW! The NERVE!
Heading to UPLANDS next! Heard the twins need entertainment!
dialog.quest_hook: Mr. Whiskers needs SPECIAL desert lizards! For... dietary reasons! Bring me FIVE and I'll perform a PRIVATE show! Just for YOU!
dialog.quest_active: Those lizards! Mr. Whiskers is PECKISH! Well, snake-ish!
dialog.quest_complete: PERFECT lizards! Mr. Whiskers is PLEASED! Here - a SNAKE CHARM! Real magic! Probably!
farewell: May your path be FREE of snakes! Unless you LIKE snakes!
Come see me in the MIRE! Or the UPLANDS! I GET around!
Remember: It's not CHARISMA if you're actually playing a FLUTE!
dialog.time_dawn: Morning shows! Mr. Whiskers is SLUGGISH! Like me BEFORE coffee!
dialog.time_noon: Hot! Mr. Whiskers loves it! I MELT! The SHOW MUST GO ON!
dialog.time_dusk: PRIME time! The SNAKE HOUR! Don't fact-check that!
dialog.time_night: Night performances! DRAMATIC lighting! Mr. Whiskers GLOWS!
dialog.post_quest_greeting: The LIZARD-BRINGER! Mr. Whiskers REMEMBERS you! Probably!
dialog.travel_plans: After this? The OBSIDIAN REACH! Then... who KNOWS! The road CALLS!

party_reactions.nix7: Scanning: Snake is... not poisonous? False advertising detected.
party_reactions.twist: CAN I PET HIM?! PLEASE?! I'LL BE GENTLE!
party_reactions.korr: The snake trusts this human. Interesting.
party_reactions.renna: It's not actually magic. Just music. Clever.

relationship_dialog.stranger: NEW audience! Welcome to the SNAKE SHOW!
relationship_dialog.acquaintance: RETURNING fan! Mr. Whiskers recognizes your FACE!
relationship_dialog.friend: My FAVORITE crowd member! FRONT ROW reserved!
relationship_dialog.best_friend: You're basically PART of the act now! Consider yourself CHARMED!

mini_quest.title: Dining with Whiskers
mini_quest.description: Collect special desert lizards for Mr. Whiskers' diet

stages.hook: Mr. Whiskers needs SPECIAL desert lizards! Bring me FIVE and I'll do a PRIVATE show!
stages.active: Five lizards! The SPOTTED kind! Mr. Whiskers is PARTICULAR!
stages.complete: EXCELLENT specimens! Mr. Whiskers sends his GRATITUDE! Here's a charm! Used in REAL snake rituals! Authentic! Mostly!
